accommodations.title: Noise-cancelling headphones
accommodations.detail: May wear them any time, including during group work and assemblies.

accommodations.title: Break pass to the quiet corner
accommodations.detail: Can leave for up to 10 minutes without asking out loud. Show the pass card; no questions in front of peers.

accommodations.title: Preferential seating
accommodations.detail: Seat at the edge of the room, away from the door, the projector fan and high-traffic paths.

accommodations.title: Warning before transitions
accommodations.detail: Give a 5-minute and a 1-minute heads-up before the class moves, stands up or switches activity.

accommodations.title: Written instructions
accommodations.detail: Key instructions also on the board or in the class chat, not spoken only.

accommodations.title: No unexpected touch
accommodations.detail: Ask before touching, even a tap on the shoulder. Approach from the front and speak quietly.

accommodations.title: Extended time (1.5x)
accommodations.detail: On tests and timed work, in a low-distraction room when possible.
